data: Is the percentage of words tagged with the POS tag 'NN' greater than 40%?

The pie chart shows the distribution of POS tags based on the output of the EM algorithm in Chinese using the 500k dataset. The percentage of words tagged with the POS tag 'NN' is explicitly stated as 42%. Since 42% is greater than 40%, the percentage of words tagged with the POS tag 'NN' is indeed greater than 40%. Therefore, the answer is yes.
